title: Survival Monitor
description: ⚠️Survival Monitor is a small client-side mod that adds messages to your gameplay about dangerous moments in the game⚠️
body:
⚠️**Survival Monitor** is a small client-side mod that adds messages to your gameplay about dangerous moments in the game. These include running out of food🥪, running out of arrows🏹, night approaching🌙, and when items are about to break❗.

📜To download the mod, install the latest version, which at the moment is **0.0.2.** Then move the file to the **.minecraft/mods** folder, launch **Minecraft 1.16.5**, and enter the game. That's it — everything is ready!✨
